taxonomy_note: Analyst planning lens; reassess actual root cause.

controls.boundary: API resource consumption and abuse limits — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Map per-operation cost, admission point, quota identity, pagination/batching and downstream fan-out. Record the product's resource/tenant fairness contract.
controls.controlled_verification: Use source cost analysis and a strictly bounded local fixture to compare a normal request with one high-amplification shape justified by the implementation. Measure admitted work/counter changes at small sizes; evaluate whether quota keys can be caller-selected or fail across tenant/session boundaries.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An unauthenticated or unlimited-looking endpoint is not automatically a denial-of-service vulnerability. Missing rate-limit headers do not establish absent enforcement or unacceptable cost.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Apply cost admission and trustworthy quota identity before expensive work, with appropriate response limits/cancellation. Retest normal workloads, original amplification and rejected-work accounting.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
